notes.title: Play Crow's Requiem OPEN PROTOTYPE 💀🚨
notes.content:
Hello, new Collectors! 🚨


Crow's Requiem open prototype has officially landed on our Itch page!


[previewyoutube="qdmrKKtDW2Y;full"][/previewyoutube]The GAMEPLAY
Join us in the Plaguelands to live your FIRST DAY AT THE JOB:



💀👉 Choose your Crow Archetype: the Listener, the Whisperer, or the Enforcer.

💀👉 Explore the map: drive your truck across the city of New Horizon;

💀👉 Meet its Citizens & Factions: who will remember your actions towards them and shape your path in the game. 

💀👉 Do the Work: receive and fulfill requests to collect the recently deceased (through the mini-game);


The CITY
Explore New Horizon and its forgotten shopping malls, where believers search for holy signs on dirty napkins. Or, enter lawless compounds where a gun speaks louder than authority.
REMEMBER, COLLECTOR:
you are one of the few in this quarantined city who still see others face-to-face daily.

You will enter temples, compounds, and barracks to reach your requested collections. Be ready, for they will each see you through the filter of their plans and creeds. 


WISHLIST & FOLLOW CROW'S
🚛👉 dig our #indiegame? Wishlist Crow's at Steam (it means a lot!) 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3859230/Crows_Requiem"][/dynamiclink]
See you all in New Horizon! 💀💚
